sources.title: City of Renton — Residential Interior Remodels
sources.supports: Interior remodel submittal: building area, existing/proposed floor layout, windows/doors, fixtures, wall section, structural stamp if needed, WSEC-R energy checklist; separate electrical/plumbing/mechanical/fire permits; email permittech@rentonwa.gov for FTP upload; no paper; first review typically 2-3 weeks; asbestos survey note; septic bedroom/bath needs King County Environmental Health approval letter; OTC list on Online Permitting Portal; inspection scheduling 425-430-7202 or portal.

sources.title: City of Renton — Building Permits FAQ
sources.supports: RMC 4-5-060E.1 permit trigger; OTC mechanical/electrical/plumbing/PV/re-roof via Civic Access Self-Service Portal (CASSP); plan-review permits via PermitTech@rentonwa.gov; no expedite option; no Basics Program; State WA contractor license + City business license required before issuance; owner may do own work except electrical (3-year residency rule); construction hours for SF remodel; COR Maps for city-limits check; cannot start work before permit issued.

sources.title: City of Renton — Online Permit Portal (CASSP)
sources.supports: Civic Access / Online Permit Portal landing used for OTC permits, inspections, and account self-service.

sources.title: City of Renton — Building, Fire, and Signs
sources.supports: Hub linking Residential Interior Remodels, FAQ, Online Permit Portal (CASSP), inspection scheduling phones, fee schedule.

sources.title: City of Renton — Permit Services
sources.supports: Permit required language for alter/convert/electrical/gas/mechanical/plumbing; PermitTech contact 425-430-7215 / permittech@rentonwa.gov.

sources.title: Washington L&I — City electrical permits and inspections list
sources.supports: Renton listed among cities that issue their own electrical permits (contrast with jurisdictions where L&I issues electrical).

sources.title: Washington L&I Verify a Contractor
sources.supports: Contractor registration, bond, and insurance verification before hire.

sources.title: Puget Sound Clean Air Agency
sources.supports: Regional asbestos rules referenced by Renton remodel page for surveys before renovation or demolition.

generation.note: All listed URLs returned HTTP 200 via curl or WebFetch on 2026-10-14. Renton is NOT a MyBuildingPermit jurisdiction for interior remodel; City uses email FTP for plan review and Civic Access for OTC trades.
